33210798.zh: 跨诊断动态脑连接研究：在一种连接状态下，精神分裂症、双相障碍和抑郁症的视觉、感觉运动及显著性等网络内部连接均降低。
33210798.en: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study found lower connectivity within visual, sensorimotor, salience and other networks in one connectivity state across schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and depression.

38665271.zh: 左右半球对应区域的连接综述：多种精神障碍中报告了连接降低，但 ADHD 的研究并未呈现同样的一致模式。
38665271.en: A review of connectivity between corresponding left- and right-hemisphere regions reported reductions across several psychiatric disorders, but not the same consistent pattern in ADHD.

29897593.zh: 跨诊断脑网络研究：患者的短距离连接较低，中长距离连接较高，不同诊断还存在区域差异。
29897593.en: A cross-disorder network study found lower short-range and higher medium- or long-range connectivity, with regional differences between diagnoses.

35264921.zh: 双相 I 型障碍研究：考察感觉运动网络的功能连接，以及它与执行功能困难的关系。
35264921.en: A bipolar I disorder study examined sensorimotor-network connectivity and its relationship to executive-function difficulties.

30837901.zh: 比较精神分裂症、抑郁症和双相障碍的脑功能活动，寻找共同变化及各诊断特有的表现。
30837901.en: A comparison of brain functional activity in schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder examined shared changes and diagnosis-specific patterns.

28360829.zh: 视觉言语任务研究：精神分裂症患者的左侧后颞下回活动及其与若干听觉、运动和岛叶区域的连接降低。
28360829.en: During a visual-speech task, schizophrenia patients showed lower left posterior inferior temporal activity and connectivity with several auditory, motor and insular regions.

32688026.zh: 未用药双相 II 型抑郁研究：部分岛叶—感觉运动连接降低，另一些岛叶连接升高，并考察了这些变化与炎症指标的关系。
32688026.en: A study of unmedicated bipolar II depression found lower connectivity in some insular–sensorimotor connections and increases in others, and examined relationships with inflammatory markers.

20631176.zh: 精神分裂症脑网络研究：患者整体连接强度降低，连接分布及网络组织也发生变化。
20631176.en: A schizophrenia network study reported lower overall connectivity strength together with changes in the distribution and organization of connections.

27748333.zh: 精神分裂症研究：感觉运动和视觉加工通路中，左右半球之间的功能连接降低。
27748333.en: A schizophrenia study found lower interhemispheric functional connectivity in sensorimotor and visual-processing pathways.

23615812.zh: 比较精神分裂症与精神病性双相障碍，发现视觉加工区域的皮层形态和功能连接存在差异。
23615812.en: A comparison of schizophrenia and psychotic bipolar disorder found differences in cortical folding and functional connectivity in visual-processing regions.

41261142.zh: 精神病性障碍的静息态成像研究：考察脑活动在时间和空间上的复杂性，描述多个网络的信息组织变化。
41261142.en: A resting-state imaging study of psychosis examined the temporal and spatial complexity of brain activity and described altered information organization across networks.

39498275.zh: 双相障碍研究：不同杏仁核分区与显著性、默认、感觉运动和视觉网络之间的连接表现不同。
39498275.en: A bipolar disorder study described distinct connectivity patterns between amygdala subregions and salience, default, sensorimotor and visual networks.

21974788.zh: 儿童 ADHD 研究：默认网络连接与内化、外化症状有关，部分关系随是否诊断 ADHD 而不同。
21974788.en: A childhood ADHD study related default-network connectivity to internalizing and externalizing symptoms, with some relationships differing by ADHD diagnosis.

23727217.zh: 精神分裂症研究：考察默认网络、显著性网络的静息态连接与症状表现之间的关系。
23727217.en: A schizophrenia study examined relationships between resting-state default and salience-network connectivity and symptoms.

40172075.zh: 跨六类精神障碍比较不同脑图谱，报告了可在不同划分方式下观察到的额叶相关连接缺陷。
40172075.en: A study comparing brain atlases across six psychiatric disorders reported frontal-related connectivity deficits observed across parcellation approaches.

26909649.zh: 未用药双相障碍的静息态研究：默认、顶叶和额叶部分区域连接降低，颞极、前扣带及部分边缘相关区域连接升高。
26909649.en: Resting-state research in unmedicated bipolar disorder found lower connectivity in some default, parietal and frontal regions and higher connectivity in temporal-pole, anterior-cingulate and limbic-related regions.

27995564.zh: 精神分裂症默认网络综述：汇总该网络的活动、结构连接、功能连接及其与任务相关网络关系的变化。
27995564.en: A review of the default network in schizophrenia summarized changes in activity, structural and functional connectivity, and relationships with task-related networks.

36717032.zh: 双相抑郁的荟萃分析：默认网络不同区域既有连接降低，也有连接升高，方向随具体位置而不同。
36717032.en: A meta-analysis of bipolar depression found both lower and higher connectivity across default-network regions, with direction varying by location.

28845172.zh: 儿童 ADHD 的平衡研究：小脑与运动前区、前扣带的连接降低，并与平衡表现有关。
28845172.en: A balance study in children with ADHD linked lower cerebellar connectivity with premotor and anterior-cingulate regions to balance performance.

35092893.zh: 首发精神病性障碍研究：在自然情境刺激下，识别出一个连接以下降为主的脑子网络。
35092893.en: A first-episode psychosis study using naturalistic stimulation identified a brain subnetwork whose connections were predominantly decreased.

41648227.zh: 早期精神病性障碍研究：分析脑活动和网络状态切换，发现部分连接指标降低、状态切换更频繁，并与记忆和症状有关。
41648227.en: An early-psychosis study examined brain activity and network-state switching, reporting reductions in some connectivity measures and more frequent switching, with links to memory and symptoms.

35634207.zh: 精神分裂症静息态研究：用正则化连接分析识别额内侧、躯体感觉及枕叶等区域的连接降低。
35634207.en: A resting-state schizophrenia study used regularized connectivity analysis to identify decreases in frontomedial, somatosensory and occipital regions.

36439199.zh: 首发精神分裂症研究：多个小脑网络之间的功能连接低于对照。
36439199.en: A first-episode schizophrenia study found lower functional connectivity between multiple cerebellar networks than in controls.

33038882.zh: 双相障碍研究：额叶眼动区、丘脑和小脑的部分眼动相关连接降低。
33038882.en: A bipolar disorder study found lower connectivity in some eye-movement-related connections among frontal eye fields, thalamus and cerebellum.

39806317.zh: 跨诊断静息态研究：ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症的程序性记忆网络连接均出现变化。
39806317.en: A transdiagnostic resting-state study reported altered procedural-memory-network connectivity in ADHD, bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.

31169117.zh: 精神分裂症影像遗传学研究：较高多基因风险与较小海马及较低海马—内侧前额叶连接有关。
31169117.en: An imaging-genetics study of schizophrenia linked higher polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi and lower hippocampal–medial prefrontal connectivity.

37688285.zh: 缓解期双相障碍研究：默认网络和执行控制网络的连接变化与认知、日常功能困难有关。
37688285.en: A study of remitted bipolar disorder related altered default and executive-control connectivity to cognitive and everyday-function difficulties.

23851068.zh: 比较精神分裂症和双相障碍的整体静息态连接，研究两类诊断是否具有共同的连接受损表现。
23851068.en: A study compared overall resting-state connectivity in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder to examine shared patterns of impaired connectivity.

37502819.zh: 儿童 ADHD 的近红外成像研究：前额叶及运动相关区域连接较低，并考察其与抑制控制困难的关系。
37502819.en: A near-infrared imaging study in children with ADHD found lower prefrontal and motor-related connectivity and examined its relationship to inhibitory-control difficulties.

36403658.zh: 社交恐惧青少年研究：比较是否共病 ADHD，发现默认网络、小脑和枕叶部分连接存在差异。
36403658.en: A study of adolescents with social phobia compared those with and without ADHD, finding differences in default-network, cerebellar and occipital connectivity.

36873218.zh: 建立正常连接参照模型，再检查精神分裂症、双相障碍和 ADHD 患者的脑网络连接偏离参照的程度。
36873218.en: A study built a normative connectivity model and examined how brain-network connectivity in schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and ADHD deviated from that reference.

29982729.zh: 早期精神病性障碍的荟萃分析：汇总默认、显著性和中央执行网络中的广泛静息态连接变化。
29982729.en: A meta-analysis of early psychosis summarized widespread resting-state connectivity changes in default, salience and central executive networks.

21077135.zh: ADHD 家庭风险研究：认知控制区域之间的连接在对照中最高、ADHD 中最低，未患病兄弟姐妹处于中间。
21077135.en: An ADHD familial-risk study found cognitive-control connectivity highest in controls, lowest in ADHD and intermediate in unaffected siblings.

26973105.zh: 遗传风险与脑结构研究：较高 AD 多基因风险与健康老年人及 MCI 人群中较小的海马有关。
26973105.en: A genetic-risk and brain-structure study linked higher AD polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi in healthy older adults and people with MCI.

34120907.zh: 纵向研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
34120907.en: A longitudinal study found faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, and faster ventricular enlargement, in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia.

39903109.zh: 大型队列研究：APOE ε4 纯合子海马和杏仁核较小，并表现出更明显的随年龄增长的认知下降。
39903109.en: A large cohort study reported smaller hippocampi and amygdalae and greater age-related cognitive decline in APOE ε4 homozygotes.

10364643.zh: 痴呆随访研究：APOE ε4 携带者的脑室体积增加较快，但同期总体认知量表变化没有相同的组间差异。
10364643.en: A dementia follow-up study found faster ventricular enlargement in APOE ε4 carriers, without the same group difference in concurrent change on a general cognitive scale.

35386118.zh: 影像遗传学研究：同时考察脑影像和认知指标，报告多基因评分与海马体积及认知功能有关。
35386118.en: An imaging-genetics study examined brain-imaging and cognitive measures and reported associations of polygenic scores with hippocampal volume and cognitive function.

27385740.zh: AD 多基因风险研究：较高评分与较小海马、较差记忆及更明显的后续认知下降和临床进展有关。
27385740.en: An AD polygenic-risk study linked higher scores to smaller hippocampi, worse memory and greater subsequent cognitive decline and clinical progression.

17097769.zh: MCI 的 MRI 随访研究：基线海马和内嗅皮层体积有助于预测后续进展。
17097769.en: An MRI follow-up study of MCI found that baseline hippocampal and entorhinal volumes helped predict subsequent progression.

20005012.zh: 脑结构研究的荟萃分析：左侧内侧颞叶萎缩是较一致的阿尔茨海默病进展预测线索。
20005012.en: A meta-analysis of brain-structure studies identified left medial temporal atrophy as a relatively consistent predictor of Alzheimer's disease progression.

42115951.zh: 纵向 MRI 研究：海马、颞中回及全脑萎缩和脑室扩大，与 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病的风险有关。
42115951.en: A longitudinal MRI study related hippocampal, middle temporal and whole-brain atrophy, and ventricular enlargement, to the risk of progression from MCI to Alzheimer's disease.

15249619.zh: 认知下降预测研究：脑室和脑脊液等影像体积指标可增加仅使用临床资料的预测模型所提供的信息。
15249619.en: A cognitive-decline prediction study found that imaging-volume measures, including ventricular and cerebrospinal-fluid measures, added information to models based on clinical data alone.

24524014.zh: MCI 随访研究：联合脑体积、遗传、淀粉样蛋白及认知指标预测进展，并比较不同随访长度下的表现。
24524014.en: An MCI follow-up study combined brain-volume, genetic, amyloid and cognitive measures to predict progression and compared performance across follow-up durations.

34615922.zh: BioFINDER 随访研究：AD 多基因风险与认知下降速度相关，部分关联与淀粉样蛋白病理有关。
34615922.en: A BioFINDER follow-up study linked AD polygenic risk to the rate of cognitive decline, with part of the relationship connected to amyloid pathology.

29860282.zh: 遗传研究识别出与疾病进展有关的位点，其中一个变异在另一队列中也与较低的 MCI 至 AD 转化风险有关。
29860282.en: A genetic study identified loci related to disease progression; one variant was also associated with lower risk of MCI-to-AD conversion in another cohort.
